summary: Full backend + frontend verification of PlayFoliyo landing page and waitlist. All 14 pytest cases passed (root, waitlist CRUD, validation, all 6 roles, duplicate 409, stats, status regression). Frontend flows verified: hero CTAs preselect correct role, modal submission shows success state + sonner toast, features tab toggle, nav join button, mobile menu toggle, footer renders.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: stats endpoint counts 'scout' under 'recruiters' bucket — intentional but undocumented; consider adding 'coaches/academies/sponsors' breakdown for richer analytics.
server.py: no index on (email, role) in waitlist collection — duplicate check relies on collection scan; add a unique compound index for scale and to prevent race-condition duplicates.
WaitlistModal.jsx: on duplicate error, prior success sonner toasts may still be visible; consider toast.dismiss() before showing new toast for clearer UX.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: Test waitlist entries created with test+<uuid>@playfoliyo.com (left in DB; harmless and tagged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers root, waitlist (create/duplicate/validation/all roles/stats), and status regression — reuse for any future changes. Frontend uses data-testid for hero-join-athlete-btn, hero-join-recruiter-btn, waitlist-modal, waitlist-form, waitlist-role-{role}, waitlist-submit, features-tab-{athletes|recruiters}, nav-join-btn, nav-mobile-toggle.
